description: One trail's facts (length, surface, states, managing organization, official website, year opened), trailheads with parking, restrooms and water, any current closure, the opening of its "About this trail" article, its numbered sources and its page URL. Takes the slug from search_trails or trails_near.

slug.description: The trail's slug, for example "great-allegheny-passage". Its page URL or exact name also work.
